problem: Write `longestSubstringNoRepeat(s)` — length of longest substring without repeating chars. Test `"abcabcbb"` → `3`, `"pwwkew"` → `3`.
Write `modPow(base, exp, mod)` — fast modular exponentiation by repeated squaring. Test `modPow(2, 10, 1000)` → `24`.
Write `simulateBank()` — global accounts dict. `open(name, balance)`, `transfer(from, to, amount)` (with overdraft check), `statement(name)`. Simulate 5 operations.
Write `shoppingCart()` — global `cart` list and `total`. `add(item, price, qty)`, `remove(item)`, `checkout()`. Simulate adding 4 items, removing 1, checking out.
Write `bookingSystem(capacity)` — global `bookings` dict. `book(name, seats)`, `cancel(name)`, `available()`. Test 3 bookings, 1 cancel on a 10-seat venue.
Write `leaderboard()` — global `scores` dict. `submit(player, score)` keeps only the best per player. `top(n)` returns `n` highest. Simulate 8 submissions from 4 players.
Write `parseMarkdown(text)` — converts `**bold**` → `[bold]`, `*italic*` → `_italic_`, `# Heading` → `=== Heading ===`. Test a 4-line markdown snippet.
Write `buildBreadcrumb(path)` — splits `"/home/user/docs/file.txt"` at `"/"` and builds `"Home > User > Docs > File.txt"`. Handle capitalisation.
Write `extractEmails(text)` — returns a list of substrings that look like email addresses (contain `@` and a `.` after it). Test a paragraph with 3 emails.
Write `censorWords(text, banned)` — replaces each banned word with `***` (case-insensitive). Test with a sentence and 3 banned words.
Write `generatePassword(length, useUpper, useDigits, useSymbols)` — builds a password by sampling from allowed character categories. Print 5 generated passwords.
Write `diff2d(a, b)` — compares two 2D grids (same size), returns a list of `{"row":r,"col":c,"old":x,"new":y}` for differing cells. Test on 3x3 grids.
Write `applyKernel(image, kernel)` — 2D convolution of a grayscale image (list of lists) with a 3x3 kernel. Test a 5x5 image with a blur kernel `[[1,1,1],[1,1,1],[1,1,1]]` / 9.
Write `rasterise(points, width, height)` — given a list of `[x,y]` points, build a 2D char grid placing `"*"` at each point and `"."` elsewhere. Print it.
Write `parseCSV2(text, delim)` — generic CSV parser with configurable delimiter and quote char `"`. Handle `""` escape inside quoted fields. Test with `|` delimiter.
Write `countPaths(grid)` — count all paths from top-left to bottom-right in a binary grid (0=open,1=blocked) moving right/down. Test a 4x4 grid.
Write `colorGraph(adj, k)` — greedy graph coloring with at most `k` colors. Test on a 6-node graph. Print each node's color.
Write `vertexCover(adj)` — greedy vertex cover: repeatedly pick an edge, add both endpoints, remove incident edges. Test on a 6-node graph.
Write `longestBitonicSubsequence(lst)` — longest subsequence that first increases then decreases. Test `[1,11,2,10,4,5,2,1]` → `6`.
Write `stockSpan(prices)` — for each day, the span is how many consecutive days before it had price <= today. Test `[100,80,60,70,60,75,85]` → `[1,1,1,2,1,4,6]`.
Write `scoreGame(rolls)` — calculate a bowling score from a list of pin counts. Handle strikes (10 followed by next 2) and spares (10 in two rolls plus next 1). Test a perfect game → 300.
Write `mancala(board, startPit)` — one move of the Mancala game: distribute stones from `startPit` counter-clockwise. Test on a 6-pit board.
Write `mastermindScore(secret, guess)` — returns `[blacks, whites]`: blacks = exact matches, whites = right digit wrong position. Test `([1,2,3,4],[1,3,2,5])` → `[1,2]`.
Write `smallestMissingPositive(lst)` — returns the smallest positive integer not in `lst`. Test `[3,4,-1,1]` → `2` and `[1,2,3]` → `4`.
Write `longestConsecutiveSequence(lst)` — without sorting, find the longest run of consecutive integers. Test `[100,4,200,1,3,2]` → `4` (1-2-3-4).
Write `setOperations(a, b)` — given two lists, compute and print union, intersection, and difference (using dict-as-set pattern). Test `[1,2,3,4]` and `[3,4,5,6]`.
Write `multiSet(lst)` — counts multiplicity. Implement `add(v)`, `remove(v)`, `count(v)`, `total()`. Simulate 8 operations. Print final state.
Write `fenwickTree(n)` — Binary Indexed Tree for prefix sums. `update(i,delta)` and `prefixSum(i)`. Test point updates and range queries.
Write `unionFind(n)` — disjoint set union-find with path compression. `union(a,b)` and `find(a)`. Test connecting nodes in a graph and querying connectivity.
Write `lruCache2(cap)` — LRU cache using an ordered dict pattern (list of keys for recency + dict for values). Test cap=3 with 6 puts and 4 gets.
Write `minHeap(lst)` — simulate a min-heap using a list. `heapPush(v)` and `heapPop()` using sift-up/sift-down. Test inserting 7 elements then extracting all in sorted order.
Write `compressWhitespace(s)` — replaces any run of whitespace (spaces, tabs represented as multiple spaces) with a single space. Test `"a   b\t\tc"`.
Write `wrapText(s, width)` — greedy word-wrap: break text into lines of at most `width` chars, breaking at word boundaries. Test `width=20` on a 100-char sentence.
Write `diffHighlight(a, b)` — character-level diff: prints `a` with changed chars replaced by `"[old→new]"`. Test `("hello","hallo")` → `"h[e→a]llo"`.
Write `slugifyUnique(title, existing)` — creates a slug from `title` and appends `-2`, `-3`... if already in `existing` dict. Test 4 calls with duplicates.
Write `mutableString(s)` — since strings are immutable, simulate a mutable string as a list of characters. Implement `set(i,c)`, `insert(i,c)`, `delete(i)`, `toString()`. Test.
Write `parseNumber(s)` — parses integers and floats, handles leading `+`/`-`, rejects invalid input by returning `null`. Test `"  -42 "`, `"3.14"`, `"abc"`, `"+7"`.
Write `regexLite(pattern, s)` — supports only `.` (any char) and literal chars. Returns `true` if `pattern` matches anywhere in `s`. Test `("h.llo", "hello world")` → `true`.
Write `scanTokens(code)` — tokenizes a tiny language with identifiers, integers, and symbols `+,-,*,/,(,)`. Return list of `{"type":"...","val":"..."}` dicts.
Write `typecheckAST(node, env)` — walks an AST, checks that referenced variables exist in `env` dict. Return `true` if type-safe, else print the missing var.
Write `prettyAST(node, indent)` — pretty-prints a nested AST dict with indentation. Test on a 3-level expression tree.
Write `constantFold(node)` — simplifies an AST by evaluating sub-expressions whose children are both literals. Test `3 + (4 * 2)` → folded to `11`.
Write `inOrderTraversal(node)` — traverses a binary tree stored as nested dicts `{"val":N,"left":...,"right":...}`. Print values in order.
Write `huffmanFreq(s)` — counts character frequencies in `s`, builds a priority queue of `[freq, char]` pairs (sorted list), and simulates Huffman tree merges. Print final tree structure.
Write `ackermann(m, n)` — Ackermann function. Test only for small inputs: `A(0,0)=1`, `A(1,1)=3`, `A(2,2)=7`, `A(3,3)=61`. Guard against `m>3`.
Write `yangHui(n)` — Pascal's triangle (Yang Hui triangle) to `n` rows stored as a list of lists. Print formatted so each row is centered.
Write `partitions(n)` — print all integer partitions of `n` in lexicographically descending order. Test `n=5`.
Write `necklaces(n, k)` — count distinct binary necklaces of length `n` with exactly `k` ones (using Burnside's lemma approximation). Test `(6,3)` → `3`.
Write `antColony(graph, ants, iters)` — ACO on a weighted graph. Pheromone matrix starts uniform. Each iter: ants traverse, update pheromones. Print best path after `iters`.
Write `selfReference()` — a function that prints its own source code (a quine-style challenge). Declare the code as a string, store it, and print it. Verify the output matches.
